title: Crazy Eights
howTo: Fold a sheet into eight panels and sketch one idea per panel in eight minutes.

title: 1-2-4-All
howTo: Think alone for a minute, share in pairs, then in fours, then gather the whole room.

title: Dot Voting
howTo: Give everyone three dots and let them vote on the options without discussion first.

title: Five Whys
howTo: Ask why a problem happens, then ask why again about each answer, five times.

title: Silent Brainstorm
howTo: Write ideas on sticky notes in silence for five minutes before anyone speaks.

title: How Might We
howTo: Turn each problem statement into a question that starts with How might we.

title: Fishbowl
howTo: Seat a few people in an inner circle to talk while the rest listen, then swap.

title: Pre-mortem
howTo: Imagine the project failed a year from now and list every reason why.
